item.title: Lab Awards at the 2026 National Collegiate Innovation Competition
item.description: Lab members participated in the National Collegiate Industry–Academia Innovation and Practical Implementation Competition (2026 全國大專院校產學創新實作競賽), securing the Special Award (陳聰林創毅特別獎) for a mudskipper-inspired robot and an Honourable Mention (佳作) for an automatic tea-picking robot.

item.title: Lab Wins Silver Award at 2026 AgriTech Competition
item.description: Lab members received the Silver Award (銀獎) at the 2026 Agricultural Innovation Technology Competition (農業創新科技競賽) for developing a robotic tea-harvesting system. The project demonstrates the potential of robotics to improve efficiency and automation in agricultural operations.
